companies.name: littleBits
companies.funding_notes: ~$59.8M total raised per the company (Bloomberg, 2015): $15.6M over four earlier rounds plus a $44.2M Series B led by DFJ Growth (Jun 2015) with Grishin Robotics participating. Acquired by Sphero in Aug 2019 (terms undisclosed). Input website is sphero.com (the acquirer).

companies.name: Ring
companies.funding_notes: ~$209M total raised per Ring (Jan 2017), which includes a small, undisclosed amount of Silicon Valley Bank debt in the $109M Series D; earlier rounds included a $28M round led by Richard Branson (2015) and a $61.2M Series C (Mar 2016, Kleiner Perkins). Acquired by Amazon in 2018, reported at over $1B.

companies.name: eero
companies.description: Future of home wifi (Acquired by Amazon)
companies.funding_notes: ~$87M total raised as of May 2016 per Fortune (TechCrunch said ~$90M): seed (Menlo participated), $35M Series B (Nov 2015), $50M growth round led by Menlo Ventures with Index (May 2016; labelled Series C here). Later rounds not publicly detailed. Acquired by Amazon (announced Feb 2019).

companies.name: Spin
companies.funding_notes: $8M Series A led by Grishin Robotics (May 2017) is the only publicly reported venture round before Ford acquired Spin in Nov 2018 (deal value reported at ~$40M to ~$100M; Reuters said Ford would invest ~$200M). Ford later sold Spin (2023, to Tier) — not re-verified here.

companies.name: LFG
companies.description: SaaS for gaming communities (Acquired by Xsolla)
companies.funding_notes: Company is LF.Group (LFG). $1M pre-seed from Grishin Robotics (Sep 2022). Acquired by Xsolla in Jul 2024 (undisclosed). No website given in input; identity matched via Xsolla's acquisition announcement.

companies.name: Ziva Dynamics
companies.description: Technology behind unforgettable characters (Acquired by Unity)

investors: Millennium Technology Value Partners (New Horizons Fund)

companies.funding_notes: $7M seed (May 2020) led by Grishin Robotics, Toyota AI Ventures and Millennium's New Horizons Fund. SEC Form D filings also show ~$1.98M (May 2021) and ~$3.0M (Oct 2021) in further sales (round type not stated), so the total may be ~$12M. Acquired by Unity in Jan 2022.

companies.name: Noise
companies.description: Make your brand go mega viral
companies.funding_notes: $5.5M seed co-led by Capital Midwest, M25 and Grishin Robotics (reported Sep 2026, per TechCrunch), bringing total funding to $7.2M; the earlier ~$1.7M isn't broken out publicly. Founded 2025 by Diego Kafie (ex-Playbite).

companies.name: Squido Studio
companies.description: Unique VR games with a gameplay-first approach

grants.name: Canada Media Fund – Innovation and Experimentation Program (led CA$1.5M round)
Canada Media Fund – Innovation and Experimentation Program (part of 2024 round)

companies.funding_notes: CA$3.7M seed led by Triptyq Capital (Nov 2024; GamesBeat reported it as $3M). That figure includes ~$1.1M from the Canada Media Fund, so private equity was ~CA$2.6M. Separately, a CA$1.5M Nov 2023 round was led by the Canada Media Fund with in-kind/program partners. Montreal-based maker of DigiGods.

companies.name: Arctic7
companies.funding_notes: $2M seed led by Grishin Robotics plus two angels (Mar 2022). In 2026 Arctic 7, Inc. filed a Reg CF (StartEngine) offering, max ~$1.23M; results not confirmed.

companies.name: Kadama
companies.description: A new way for Gen-Z to learn
companies.funding_notes: $1.7M seed led by Grishin Robotics (Jun 2021). Seattle-area tutoring app. No later rounds found.

companies.name: The Skills
companies.funding_notes: $5M seed led by Will Ventures (Dec 2020); Sports Business Journal called it a Series A. Athlete-taught online courses. No later rounds found.

companies.name: Rogue
companies.funding_notes: Rogue Games: $1.25M seed led by Grishin Robotics (Mar 2019); $2M led by Runa Capital (May 2020; company said $3.4M total to date, so ~$0.15M is unaccounted for); $2.5M from Riva Technology and Entertainment (Mar 2021). ~$5.75M from announced rounds (~$5.9M using the company's own running total).

companies.name: Taskade
companies.funding_notes: YC alum; $5M seed from Grishin Robotics and Y Combinator (Oct 2019). Databases mention a small 2020 round with Sequoia/Index, but no primary source was found, so it isn't counted.

companies.name: Solid
companies.funding_notes: Formerly Wise (renamed 2021). $80.7M total raised: $5.7M seed (Apr 2020), $12M Series A (Oct 2020), $63M Series B led by FTV Capital (Aug 2022). Filed for Chapter 11 Subchapter V in Delaware in Apr 2025 (case 25-10669); a liquidation plan was later confirmed. Seed/Series A leads come from search summaries, not re-read in full.

companies.name: Club Feast
companies.funding_notes: $13.75M total raised: $3.5M Seed I led by General Catalyst (closed Dec 2020, announced Jan 2021) and a $10.25M Seed II led by General Catalyst with Grishin Robotics (May 2021). No later rounds found.

companies.name: Zume
companies.funding_notes: Formerly Zume Pizza. ~$445M total raised (Axios), including $375M from SoftBank Vision Fund (Nov 2018, ~$2.25B valuation per WSJ) and a $48M Series B led by AME Cloud Ventures (Oct 2017; the source for that round is a secondary aggregator). Closed pizza delivery and pivoted to compostable packaging in Jan 2020; shut down in Jun 2023.

companies.name: Robot Lab

funding_rounds.stage: Accelerator (Kaplan EdTech Accelerator powered by Techstars)

companies.funding_notes: RobotLAB (founder Elad Inbar). Grishin Robotics put $250K into Inbar's earlier RobotAppStore in 2012. RobotLAB was in the 2014 Kaplan EdTech Accelerator powered by Techstars (standard ~$20K, plus an optional $150K Kaplan note). No priced seed or later rounds publicly reported. The RobotAppStore/RobotLAB link is from a search summary, not confirmed.

companies.name: Spire
companies.description: Space to cloud data analytics company
companies.funding_notes: Spire Global (NYSE: SPIR). Private rounds included a Series A (amount not re-verified), $40M Series B led by Promus (Jun 2015), $70M Series C (Nov 2017) and $40M+ (Sep 2019). Went public via a NavSight SPAC merger in Aug 2021 with ~$265M gross proceeds ($245M PIPE). Total private equity isn't clearly sourced, so amount_raised is left blank.

companies.name: Zipline
companies.description: Vital, On-Demand Delivery for the World
companies.funding_notes: ~$821M raised through the $330M Series F at a $4.2B valuation (Apr 2023), then an $800M Series H ($600M+ in Jan 2026 at a $7.6B valuation, plus $200M in Mar 2026). That's at least ~$1.6B; total not stated by a primary source, and the Series G wasn't located, so amount_raised is blank. Bloomberg (Sep 2026) reported talks on ~$1B at a $20B valuation (unconfirmed).

companies.name: Embodied
companies.funding_notes: Maker of the Moxie kids' robot. $22M Series A led by Calibrate Ventures (Jun 2018), the only round confirmed from a primary source, so the $22M is a floor (databases report ~$44M total). Shut down in Dec 2024 after a lead investor pulled out of a round.

companies.name: Starship Technologies
companies.funding_notes: 'More than $280M' total funding per Starship (Oct 2025), which includes a €50M European Investment Bank venture-debt facility (Mar 2022) and other pre-2019 funding (~$45M before the Series A). Founded by Skype co-founders Ahti Heinla and Janus Friis.

companies.name: Double Robotics
companies.funding_notes: YC company. Raised ~$2M in 2012 from SK Ventures, Grishin Robotics ($250K, Grishin's first investment), Y Combinator and angels (per the CEO, VentureBeat 2017); round type not stated. It planned a Series A in 2017 but none was found. Profitable and revenue-funded (>$20M sales by 2017).

companies.name: Occipital
companies.funding_notes: ~$33M raised as of Jan 2018 (TechCrunch): $13M Series B (Jul 2015, bringing the total to ~$21M) and $12M of a planned $15M Series C led by Foundry Group. Databases mention later funding (~$41–46M lifetime, incl. a 2025 round), but no primary source was found. Maker of the Structure Sensor.

companies.name: Sphero
companies.funding_notes: Formerly Orbotix; Techstars and Disney Accelerator alum. ~$35M raised before 2015 (incl. ~$20M in 2014; investors included Grishin Robotics, Highway 12, Shea, SK Ventures). Then $45M led by Mercato (Jun 2015) and ~$26.9M equity per SEC filings (May 2018–Jul 2019), so ~$107M approx. Also raised ~$1M on Kickstarter (RVR, 2019). Acquired littleBits in 2019.

companies.name: Bolt
companies.funding_notes: Bolt is a hardware-focused seed/pre-seed venture firm (formerly a Boston incubator), not an operating startup. Grishin Robotics, Logitech and Autodesk backed it in 2013 (reported ~ $1M each, not confirmed). Bolt closed a $25M fund in 2015 with Grishin as an LP. Fund capital isn't company equity, so no round/amount is recorded.

companies.name: Swivl
companies.funding_notes: $500K from Grishin Robotics (May 2013), round type not stated. Earlier ~$157K Kickstarter (2013). In Jan 2025 it got undisclosed growth/debt financing from Decathlon Capital Partners (not equity). Databases list other small seed rounds (2013/2018) with no primary source.
